start: Owner signed in online on a computer, any page but the assistant page

user_sees: A round orange button with a sparkle and "AI Assistant"
must_not: The button over a page button or a sheet
The button before the server has answered about credits

user_sees: A side panel on the right; the page moves over to make room
Header "AI Assistant", the credits number, a × to close
Tabs "Ask" and "History"
"Today for you" (when there are ideas), "Try saying", "See all {n} things it can do"
"Asking is free. A task uses credits only when you send or save it."
The box "Ask or give a task, in Hindi or English"

The floating button still shows over the panel

user_sees: The panel closes, the button is back, the page has its width again
must_not: The chat is lost on opening again

start: Owner signed in online on a phone

user_sees: The assistant as a full page; the floating button is gone on that page
must_not: A side panel squeezed onto the phone

steps.action: Go back, scroll a long page down, then up
user_sees: The button shrinks to a round sparkle while scrolling down and shows its words again going up
must_not: The button covers the bottom bar

user_sees: The button is hidden while typing and while a sheet is open
must_not: The button over the keyboard or over a sheet's buttons

user_sees: The assistant page, centred, with the same header, tabs and box
must_not: A blank page

start: The side panel is open on a computer

steps.action: Make the window narrow like a phone
user_sees: The panel closes; the floating button stays
must_not: A panel wider than the window

user_sees: "Loading…", then the tasks newest first: the request, what it did, the India time, "Not sent", "Done", "Cancelled" or "Did not work", and the credits of a done task

With no internet: "History could not load. Check the internet and try again."

user_sees: The Ask tab with that request in the box, not yet asked
must_not: The task done again by the tap
